## MSWorlds (My Special Worlds)
MSWorlds is a mod that aims to expand your Minecraft experience by adding unique new dimensions to explore.
🌑 Current Status:
The mod is currently in active development.
Progress: 2 out of 3 planned worlds is already implemented.
Created by: BimShim
Made with: MCreator
World updates: Stay tuned for 1 more special world coming soon!
